> WE’LL OBSESS OVER THE DETAIL S . YOU ENJOY THE RIDE
At Mitsubishi Motors, we’re obsessed with achieving perfection. In
fact, there’s a Japanese word for this sort of obsession: Kodawari,
which means “in pursuit of perfection.” The three main pillars of the
Kodawari discipline are passion, persistence and precision. To harness
Kodawari and realize our ideals, we apply these pillars to each and
every vehicle we create.
Why do we yearn for perfection? Why do we hold ourselves to such
high standards? What inspires our attention to detail? The answer
is simple: you. Our customers. The people who drive our cars. Those
who appreciate uncompromising craftsmanship and a pioneering
spirit. The ones who don’t mind being a bit unconventional, even if
it means breaking the mold. Some call it idealistic, but for us, it’s
simply Kodawari.

M I R A G E & M I R A G E G 4
> T HE REAL DEA L
The 2024 Mirage hatchback and Mirage G4 sedan bring Mitsubishi
ambitions to life. Sporting sleek available LED headlights, a 1.2L
three-cylinder engine and Active Stability Control,1 the Mirage’s
lightweight body can turn on a dime, taking tight corners with
precision and control. Adding generous standard features to the
equation, it also puts smart technology and advanced safety
features at your fingertips. Part urban cruiser and part compact
commuter, its winning combination of flare and functionality make
entry level look like the big league. Plus, with a combined 39 MPG
for the Mirage2 and 37 MPG for the Mirage G43 you’ll enjoy a minimal
footprint and class-leading mileage from one of the most fuel-
efficient cars in America.
Such style, comfort and convenience make the Mirage a driver’s
dream come true.
Optional features shown. Available at additional cost. Visit mitsubishicars.com for more information.

> 0 1 FUEL EFFICIENT AT E VERY T URN
The Mirage is a compact car with big impact. With a lighter body
weight that optimizes fuel efficiency, you get 39 combined MPG² for
the Mirage and 37 combined MPG³ for the Mirage G4. At the same
time, the sharp turning radius makes it ideal for navigating narrow
city streets and maneuvering curves and corners. For more road
responsiveness, Active Stability Control¹ uses sensors to monitor
the grip of your tires. If one of the wheels starts to slip, the system
works with the Mirage’s Anti-Lock Braking to help you maintain
traction and control.

pages.text:
THE 2024 MIRAGE & MIRAGE G4 > 03 SAFETY
> 03 A SENSE FOR SAFET Y
Equipped with our latest advanced safety features, the 2023 Mirage and
Mirage G4 offer peace of mind on rough roads and in tough conditions.
Standard Forward Collision Mitigation system with Pedestrian
Detection7 monitors the road, letting you know when it senses
something up ahead. If you don’t respond when the system issues
an alert, it attempts to slow the vehicle by applying the brakes to
help avoid a collision.
The Mirage’s airbag system⁸ provides additional protection, too.
Its Advanced Dual Stage Front, Side Curtain and Driver Knee
airbags join forces to help protect you in an accident. Plus, on top
of the six standard airbags, the Mirage also adds a seventh airbag
underneath the driver’s side dashboard. In the event of a collision,
the Reinforced Impact Safety Evolution (RISE) body construction
is designed to help route and absorb energy for greater protection.
Crumple zones and other strategic reinforcements at key points
reduce the force of impact and complement the vehicle’s side-
impact door beams.
Optional features shown. Available at additional cost. Visit mitsubishicars.com for more information.

THE 2024 MIRAGE & MIRAGE G4 > 05 INTERIOR DESIGN
> 05 THE INSIDE STORY
Enjoy your personal space. Despite its compact size, the Mirage G4’s
interior cabin feels spacious, delivering a generous amount of storage
and legroom. Flexible, functional and comfortable, the available
combination leather and fabric seating offers room for up to five
passengers. But it’s not just about who’s coming with you — the Mirage
G4 is ready to handle all your stuff too, with 12.4 cubic feet of trunk
space. On the other hand, the Mirage Hatchback provides an incredible
17.1 cubic feet of cargo space with the seats folded up, and 47 cubic
feet of cargo space with the seats folded down, for plenty of storage
configurations. Pack easy and take whatever you need along for the
ride.
Optional features shown. Available at additional cost. Visit mitsubishicars.com for more information.
